body: Surveyor: Casa's tracks are moving to a new cloud environment, so wrap up here and write your own handoff. 1) git fetch origin claude/main. Push any unpushed work on your branch. Don't start new work. 2) At the end of your dispatch file (docs/dispatch/04-comp-report-research.md), add a section "Handoff, 2026-10-13": what you delivered (#49), the research threads still open and where each lives (the glossary draft and its 12 questions for Noble, D-17's two counsel questions, the thresholds for Noble, anything you'd have done next), gotchas about your sources, and anything waiting on Kimani or Casanova. Leave the roster and CLAUDE.md's table alone; Casanova updates them at merge. 3) In that section, write the restart kickoff for your successor session, from "Restarting a track in a new session" in docs/dispatch/README.md. You have no queued dispatch, so name it as research on call for the comp report. 4) Open a docs-only PR to claude/main with it, and paste the restart kickoff back to Kimani in chat. Never merge. Sign "— Surveyor (CR-R)". When the PR opens, mark Dispatch Ledger line casa-r7-5 delivered (rule 11).
summary: Write a handoff and the restart kickoff for the new environment.
title: Handoff: Surveyor
